description: Time Machine drive is above 95%. Per-Mac quotas (900 GB each) should cap two Macs at ~90% of the 2 TB drive, so this means the quotas are not holding

spec.name: A
spec.query: sum by ("k8s.node.name", mountpoint) ({"system.filesystem.usage", "k8s.node.name"!="ocifree", state="used", mountpoint="/var/mnt/tm"}) / (sum by ("k8s.node.name", mountpoint) ({"system.filesystem.usage", "k8s.node.name"!="ocifree", state="used", mountpoint="/var/mnt/tm"}) + sum by ("k8s.node.name", mountpoint) ({"system.filesystem.usage", "k8s.node.name"!="ocifree", state="free", mountpoint="/var/mnt/tm"})) * 100
